description_en: Queries the maximum number of connections that can be established over the ports of one or more Anti-DDoS Proxy instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的端口连接峰值信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-port-max-conns --resource-group-id default --end-time 1583683200 --start-time 1582992000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePortMaxConns
